BrochureContent.Content: Location Location Location!!! Dooley Poynton Auctioneers are delighted to present this luxury holiday mobile home located in the exclusive Jack’s Hole Beach Resort. The much-coveted sweeping coastline of Brittas Bay invites you to experience the epitome of seaside living with direct access to the private beach. The location offers magnificent Blue Flag white sandy beaches & sand dunes creating a wonderful seaside atmosphere for you to connect with family & friends, or to unwind and reconnect with nature. Relive the nostalgia of your childhood seaside memories & create many more. This property is tastefully decorated throughout with a nautical themed colour palette and is fully furnished throughout. This holiday home comprises of a bright & airy light infused, contemporary open plan kitchen/dining/living room with sliding French patio doors leading out to the generously proportioned private tiered deck area with a choice of alfresco dining/entertainment areas featuring a new white pavilion Gazebo. The property features three well-appointed bedrooms, a w/c & a family shower room. The resort offers a fantastic range of organised activities for all ages along with a variety of leisure amenities including two astro tennis courts, boules, volleyball, basketball, a games room, children's play area, soccer field, boat moorings & water sports. The property is located only a short drive from the vibrant hub of Wicklow’s Town Centre with its wonderful selection of boutique shops, cafes, bars, restaurants & leisure amenities Wicklow Harbour, Wicklow Tennis Club, Coral Leisure Centre and Wicklow Golf Club. Contact Eugene or Jennifer today for a private viewing and discover the endless possibilities that await you at JHB Resort. A.M.V €275,000

Kitchen/Dining/Living Room (2.73m x 3.65m + 3.11m x 3.65m)
This contemporary kitchen/dining/living room is a bright and inviting space overlooking the private deck area. This space is infused with natural sunlight courtesy of the large expanses of glass and is tastefully decorated with a neutral colour palette throughout. This space is the perfect blend of form & function and features a fully fitted white shaker style kitchen with worktop and a range of appliances, a fridge/freezer, free standing Normende oven & gas hob with extractor fan, Indesit dishwasher & a stainless sink unit. This space also features a bespoke built-in storage seating with a dining table and matching bench, glass lighting, roller blinds and curtain window dressings along with a contemporary light neutral toned laminate flooring throughout. The living area features a caramel leather sofa with matching chaise and ottoman. The sliding French doors lead out on to the front deck area. The front deck area showcases beautiful sea views. 


Master Bedroom 1 (2.42m x 3.65m) 
This spacious master bedroom is tastefully decorated in a mono toned teal & white colour palette, with feature wall paneling. This room also features custom built-in wardrobes providing ample storage space, a roller blind window dressing and a contemporary light-toned laminate floor throughout. 

Bedroom 2 (1.89m x 2.42m)
This cosy bedroom is located to the side of the property. This room features bunk beds, pendant lighting, a roller blind window dressing & laminate flooring throughout.
 
Bedroom 3 (2.38m x 1.61m)
This bright bedroom is located to the side of the property. This space is decorated in a neutral colour scheme and features a trundle bed, pendant lighting, a roller blind window dressing and laminate flooring throughout.

Family Shower room 
The family shower room features ceiling lighting, a walk-in pumped shower unit and a vanity unit with ceramic sink, shaving light and mirror. There is back splash mono toned ceramic subway wall tiling and laminate flooring throughout.

W/C (1.03m x 1.12m)
The separate W/C features a vanity unit complete with a ceramic wash-hand basin with shaving mirror, toilet and laminate flooring throughout.

Hallway (4.12m x 1.90m)
The hallway leads to all three bedrooms, w/c, shower room, & kitchen/dining/living room. There is also a storage cupboard housing the Combi boiler and provides a storage facility for cleaning utensils.

Patio Area
The exterior of the property features a brand-new expansive wraparound sun deck. The generously proportioned deck features a large sunken sheltered deck area, providing the perfect outdoor space to relax in total seclusion listening to the sound of the waves lapping against the seashore and is the optimum place to entertain family & friends. The large centre deck area features a brand new premium white Pavillon Gazebo with an “Outdoor Living 6 seater table & chairs” to dine in comfort and luxury with a Sahara BBQ.  The exterior of the property features outdoor lighting and an outdoor shower for added convenience.

Deck Storage Area
There is a large storage area to the rear of the property, along with a lean too providing an excellent shelter for outdoor drying, below the deck there is also ample storage space. This space also features an exterior utility area with Belling Dryer and an Indesit washing machine.
